Perks › Epic

Dead Man's Draw

Epic perk · Boneyard

With one bone left, draw one extra face-down candidate per stack, reveal them, and choose what to keep.

In-game card text

How it works

When you go to the boneyard holding exactly one bone, you pick one extra face-down bone for each copy. All of them are turned over and you choose which to keep.

  • It stacks with Sovereign Draw and Light Fingers: their extra picks add together.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeBoneyard
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
